title: Badge
description: A small count or status indicator attached to the corner of another element.

props.name: color
props.description: Semantic color of the badge

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style: `solid` (filled), `subtle` (tinted background) or `outline` (bordered)

props.name: size
props.description: Badge size

props.name: content
props.description: Content displayed inside the badge (count, short text, icon + text...). Use it instead of children for rich content of a standalone badge

props.name: position
props.description: Corner of the children the badge is placed on (ignored by standalone badges)

props.name: dot
props.description: Renders a small dot instead of content

props.name: borderRadius
props.description: Custom border radius (CSS value)

props.name: borderWidth
props.description: Custom border width (CSS value)

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label of the badge, e.g. "5 unread messages"

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon displayed before the content

props.name: role
props.description: ARIA role of the badge element; set it to "presentation" or "none" when the badge must not be announced as a live status

BadgeProps.description: Props of the Badge. Colors come from the theme tokens of `color`. To override them for a single badge, set these CSS custom properties (e.g. through `style` or a class): `--badge-bg` (background), `--badge-fg` (text) and `--badge-border` (border color of the `outline` variant).

props.name: children
props.description: Element the badge is attached to. Without children (or with plain text / number children, used as the content) the badge renders inline in the normal flow instead of being positioned on a corner

props.name: className
props.description: Additional class name of the badge

props.name: color
props.description: Semantic color of the badge

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style: `solid` (filled), `subtle` (tinted background) or `outline` (bordered)

props.name: size
props.description: Badge size

props.name: content
props.description: Content displayed inside the badge (count, short text, icon + text...). Use it instead of children for rich content of a standalone badge

props.name: position
props.description: Corner of the children the badge is placed on (ignored by standalone badges)

props.name: dot
props.description: Renders a small dot instead of content

props.name: borderRadius
props.description: Custom border radius (CSS value)

props.name: borderWidth
props.description: Custom border width (CSS value)

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label of the badge, e.g. "5 unread messages"

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon displayed before the content

props.name: role
props.description: ARIA role of the badge element; set it to "presentation" or "none" when the badge must not be announced as a live status

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the root element: the wrapper when attached to children, otherwise the badge itself

vars.name: --badge-bg
vars.description: Background color (overrides the color and variant)

vars.name: --badge-fg
vars.description: Text color (overrides the color and variant)

vars.name: --badge-border
vars.description: Border color of the subtle and outline variants

vars.name: --badge-ring-color
vars.description: Color of the ring separating an attached (corner) badge from its content (defaults to --surface-color)

examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: Notification and message badges show 5 and 99+; inline badges mark Inbox 12 and a New changelog.

examples.title: Colors
examples.description: color sets the semantic color: primary (default), neutral, success, warning, danger and info.

examples.title: Custom styles
examples.description: borderRadius and borderWidth adjust the shape. To change the colors, set the CSS custom properties --badge-bg, --badge-fg and --badge-border (inline, in a class or on a parent element).

examples.title: Dot
examples.description: dot replaces the content with a small dot, for "something new" indicators.

examples.title: Positions
examples.description: Attach the badge to any corner with position.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: Three sizes: small, medium (default) and large.

examples.title: Status dot
examples.description: A standalone dot next to a text label shows the status of an item or the presence of a user. Give the dot role="presentation" when the text already names the status, or an aria-label otherwise.

examples.title: Variants
examples.description: variant sets the visual style: solid (default), subtle (tinted background) or outline (bordered). Every variant works with every color.

examples.title: With icon
examples.description: icon is displayed before the content.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: With an element child the badge is attached to its corner and shows content; with text only it is a standalone badge.

colors-variants.title: Colors, variants and sizes
colors-variants.description: Six colors, three variants and three sizes; border-radius and border-width customize the shape.

positions.title: Positions and dots
positions.description: position picks the corner of the child. A dot badge has no text: give it an aria-label, or badge-role="presentation" when it must not be announced.

slots.title: Icons, rich content and updates
slots.description: The icon slot adds an icon, the content slot rich content. content is a property: click the button to update the count.

props.badgeRole: ARIA role of the badge (default "status"; "presentation" or "none" stops announcing it).

slots.default: Element the badge is attached to, or the text of a standalone badge.
slots.content: Rich content of the badge (instead of content).
